description: Authenticated, read-only polling for a previously submitted paid machine job. Use the job_id returned by submit_paid_machine_job to retrieve its current queued, working, completed, or failed state and any available result; use quote_paid_machine_job before submission, not this tool, when you only need a price estimate.

job_id.description: PaidHandshake job identifier returned by submit_paid_machine_job. Pass the exact job_id for the authenticated machine account whose status or completed result you want to retrieve.

name: get_paid_machine_job
